articles.title: Nipha Group plans to expand agri machinery business across 20 states, 10 countries
articles.summary: Kolkata-based Nipha Group has launched 'OneHorn' to significantly expand its agriculture machinery business. This strategic initiative aims to penetrate at least 20 Indian states and 10 international markets, including the US and Europe. The move underscores an Indian company's ambition to boost its presence and competitiveness in the global agricultural equipment sector, contributing to national economic growth and international trade.

articles.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles into sea
articles.summary: North Korea has test-fired multiple short-range ballistic missiles, as reported by South Korea's military. This event marks the latest in a recent series of launches by the nuclear-armed state, intensifying regional tensions. For an SSB aspirant, this underscores the continued development of North Korea's missile capabilities and its implications for international security and stability in East Asia.

articles.title: 22k gold rate today on Akshaya Tritiya 2026: Check 24k, 22k, 18k gold prices (April 19, 2026) in New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and other cities
articles.summary: Akshaya Tritiya is revered as one of the most auspicious days, particularly for purchasing gold. People widely believe that any positive action or investment undertaken on this day brings lasting success and prosperity. This deep-rooted traditional belief highlights its cultural significance, making it an important occasion for many to initiate new ventures and make symbolic purchases, reflecting a hope for future well-being.

articles.title: Defence stocks breakout: Should you book profits or buy the dip? Anand James answers
articles.summary: Defence stocks are currently surging, exhibiting double-digit gains and attracting significant investor attention. While this indicates strong growth within the defence sector, key heavyweights are showing 'overbought' signals, prompting questions about potential market saturation or the need for cautious investment. This trend reflects the dynamic financial health and investment landscape surrounding India's defence industry, relevant for aspirants tracking economic developments in the sector.

articles.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles towards sea off its east coast
articles.summary: North Korea recently fired ballistic missiles into the sea, marking an acceleration in its launch activities. These provocations occur amid heightened Iran war tensions and discussions regarding potential diplomatic meetings with the US and South Korea. This underscores Pyongyang's continued military assertiveness, posing a challenge to regional stability and international diplomacy.

articles.title: India must remain ready for West Asia fallout, says Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized India's need for preparedness against any sudden escalation in the volatile West Asia conflict. He underscored the importance of a robust defence strategy to safeguard national interests amidst global instability. This highlights India's proactive stance in monitoring international geopolitical developments and ensuring readiness for potential regional challenges impacting its security.
